tasks.name: 작열하는 송곳
tasks.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE tiny 32x32 pixel-art inventory relic for a Unity 2D fantasy roguelike.
Image 1 is the edit target: the original relic. Image 2 contains FIVE approved fire relics, used strictly for pixel style and the shared palette. Do not add any of those five objects.
Create a fresh remake with the exact clean, simple, chunky rendering of image 2. Intended logical canvas EXACTLY 32x32, not a detailed drawing later squeezed down. Use a visibly coarse grid of perfectly square pixels and large flat connected color clusters. Consistent TWO logical pixel dark charcoal outer contour, stepped edges. Minimal interior detail and one small pale highlight. At least TWO completely transparent logical pixels on EVERY side, including the full outline. Keep natural proportions, no stretching.
Use ONLY SIX opaque colors TOTAL, including the outline: #363232 charcoal outline, #A75064 muted red shade, #E55C5C red, #E09656 orange, #EECF5A yellow, #F1E9D4 cream. Use these same six colors as the approved fire relics; no gray, white, blue or purple additions. Cream occupies a very small hot highlight. No gradients, dithering, texture noise, speckling, antialiasing, gloss, blur, cast shadows, external glow, halo or detached tiny sparks. Real transparent background.
Exactly one centered isolated icon, no text, no letters, no frame, no labels, no grid, no scenery. If displaying enlarged, each logical pixel must be an equal square and the silhouette must still work at native 32x32.

Subject: SCORCHING AWL. Retain the original diagonal direction: a long red-hot pointed spike extends toward the lower LEFT, while the compact handle/head sits toward the upper RIGHT. The tip must be distinctly pointed, with a thicker tapering solid shaft behind it. Give the short handle a simple stout cap and a small broad shoulder near the shaft, using red and muted red. The hot spike is red/orange with one simple yellow stripe and a tiny cream hot area. It should read as an enchanted piercing tool, not a feather, torch, sword, key or a loose flame. Fill the available height while keeping enough width for the outline; no isolated sparks or decorative curls.

Subject: PORTABLE BRAZIER. The user explicitly allows changing the original shape because the old tall cage does not look like a brazier. Redesign it so a brazier is instantly recognizable at 32 pixels: a LOW, WIDE, squat round open fire bowl, a clearly visible thick elliptical ORANGE rim seen slightly from above, a RED lower vessel with a muted-red underside, TWO short sturdy support feet and a little charcoal gap between them. A compact simple YELLOW/ORANGE flame rises from visible hot coals INSIDE THE OPEN BOWL, with just one small cream hot core. A pair of short thick side stubs may suggest handles but must not distract. The opening and wide bowl must remain legible and take more width than the flame. The bright flame is ABOVE the bowl rim, not a round glowing emblem on the front wall. No tall upper cage, arch, carrying loop, long neck, grill bars, smoke plume, lid, ornate carving, long legs or long stand. It should read as a small solid portable fire bowl resting securely on its feet, not a lantern, perfume bottle, hanging pendant, cooking pot with lid or ordinary campfire pile. Keep the total object compact and nearly square with clear separation between flame, open rim and lower body.

Subject: SUN FRAGMENT. Retain the original upright asymmetric FLAME-SHAPED fragment silhouette, a solid chunky ember tapering to an irregular upward point with one short side spur. Give it a coherent gem-like mass without a setting: a broad bright yellow center, orange transition, red outer surface and a simple muted-red facet on the lower right, plus a tiny cream hot highlight.
